desc:
👍 LIKE + JOIN GROUP for more UPDATES 👍
Welcome to Clean the Pet Shop! 🐾

🖥️ PC Controls:
E or Click - Pickup / Place item
Q - Drop item
B - Unlock Mouse

🎮 Controller Controls:
RT - Pick Up / Place item
B - Drop item
X - Unlock Thumbstick

🐾 Your local pet shop has been turned upside down! Food, bowls, toys and even the animals are scattered everywhere. Sort it all back onto the right shelves before the shop gets out of control!

👥 Clean alone or with friends
🐶 Catch loose kittens, puppies, bunnies and guinea pigs
🏆 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard
🔓 Earn cash and unlock upgrades and abilities
